The issuer displays a massive asset base of $404.3 billion and substantial revenue of $36.4 billion with strong profitability (80% gross margin and $5.0 billion in operating income). However, the capital structure is highly leveraged with total liabilities of $298.5 billion (producing a debt-to-equity or leverage profile that weighs on the credit profile) and a tight liquidity position indicated by a current ratio of 0.91 ($56.9 billion in current assets versus $62.4 billion in current liabilities). Balancing its immense scale and solid profitability against its highly leveraged balance sheet and short-term liquidity deficit positions the issuer in the upper-medium grade category.

DECISION: A-
